content: Kuxineriyu Pekuru kemɨtiutanɨ'airi
Hikɨ tewi Tsetsareyatsie pukatei Kuxineriyu titewatɨ xeitsienituyari kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨatɨ. Mɨkɨ kuyaxi 'Itariyatsie mepɨkiekataritɨkai.
Mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari 'ayemakatɨ yakatinikamiekaitɨni, meta yunaitɨ kiena kiekatari. Waɨkawa katiniyurienekaitɨni teɨteri wahetsiemieme wanenimayatɨ, Kakaɨyari nenewieri pɨpitɨakai yuheyemekɨ.
Hikɨ xeitukaritsie tau kɨa kakaiku heinɨtsi hepaɨ 'aneme kaniuxeiya. Kakaɨyari niukieya tuayame hepana 'amiekame kaniuxeiya, mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨaweme: —Kuxineriyu 'aku.

Kuxineriyu 'ixeiyatɨ waɨkamekɨ kanimakaitɨni mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —¿Ketita 'aku neti'aitɨwame? Niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Kakaɨyari 'anenewieri kaniu'enieni 'anenimayatsika meta 'a'uximayatsikatsie kepemɨtiyuriene mawari pewewietɨ.
Hikɨ teɨteri Kupe paitɨ keniwaranunɨ'a Tsimuni Pekuru mɨtitewa memɨwitɨyukɨ.
Mɨkɨ Tsimuni nawi 'uayame hetsɨa kanekani, kiya haramara tetsita kaneweni. Mɨkɨ kamatinitaxatɨamɨkɨ kemɨreuyewetse yapemɨtiyurienenikɨ.
Hikɨ niuki tuayame tiutaxataka heyaku, Kuxineriyu yuhutame yunɨ'arima yu'aurie pɨwarutahɨawixɨ meta kuya Kakaɨyari mayexeiyakai, memiparewiekai yuheyemekɨ.
Naime tiwarutahekɨatɨaka kemɨtiuyɨkai, Kupe paitɨ kaniwarenɨ'ani.
Pekuru tita mɨtiuxei
'Uxa'arieka mexi'akuxi huyeta me'uhukaku kiekari 'aurie me'aye'axɨaximekaku Pekuru kii heima manawerikaitsie kaneutiyani tuka yutanenewienike.
Kanekahakamɨkatɨyani, mexi'akuxi 'ikwai wewiyakai, katiniuheinɨni.
Muyuawi 'anakayepiekame kaniuxeiya meta tsawana hepaɨ ti'anekame katiniuxeiya 'arakamieme, tetsitana naukakɨa tiwiwietɨkaime kwiepa paitɨ kanakatuiyani.
Mɨkɨtsie mekanati'ukaitɨni yunaitɨ kwiepa memɨte'u'uwa nauka 'ɨkayari memexeiyatɨka, kuterixi meta memɨte'awɨwawe.
Xewitɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Pekuru kenanukukexi, keniwarukwika meta keniwarutikwa'i.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ti'aitame pɨkatixaɨxuari. Hatsuaku nepɨkatitikwaiwe 'axamɨti'anene mɨkati'itiyatɨka.
Hutarieka mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Tita Kakaɨyari mɨti'itie 'axati'anenekame pepɨkati'erieka.
Haikakɨa mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni, hikɨta kwitɨwa tsawana panutihanie taheima.
Pekuru 'atsipɨkaretimaitɨyeikakai titakɨ mɨti'ayumiemetɨkai heinɨtsi. Hikɨ mexi'akuxi teɨteri Kuxineriyu mɨwareyenɨ'akai, kitenie me'u'axɨaka Tsimuni kiya hepaɨtsita mekaniuta'iwauni.
Meku'iwawatɨ mekaniutiniere xɨka Tsimuni Pekuru mɨtitewa muwa 'ayekateitɨni.
Mexi'akuxi Pekuru yu'iyaritɨakai kemɨtiunierekai hepaɨtsita, 'Iyari mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Neuxei Tsimuni, teɨteri yuhaikatɨ mepɨmatsiwautɨwe.
Mexuima, mana keneukaye'a, wahamatɨa kenemie peka'a'iyaritɨatɨ, netsɨ nepɨwareyenɨ'a».
Pekuru 'anakayaka hake memeti'ukai teɨteri mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Ne nekanihɨkɨtɨni, xeme xemɨnetsiwautɨwe. ¿Tita xetehayexeiyatɨ xetekɨyɨa?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Kuxineriyu xeitsienituyari kuyaxi mɨtiwa'aitɨwame tatsiheyenɨ'aku tepeyekɨ, mɨkɨ heitseriemekɨ yapɨtiyuriene meta Kakaɨyari kanayemakaxeni, yunaitɨ huriyutsixi mekaneyemakaxekaitɨni. Kakaɨyari niukieya tuayame mɨpaɨ katinita'aitɨani 'ekɨ kiena pemɨmiekɨ, mɨmatsi'enienikɨ niuki 'ekɨ pemitaxatɨanikɨ.
Hikɨ Pekuru kiita kaniwareuta'inieni, muwa memayehenikɨ. Pekuru Kuxineriyu kemɨreku'iwataxɨ 'Uxa'arieka 'anukukeka wahamatɨa kaneyani. Hipatɨta 'iwamarixi Kupetsie kiekatari wahamatɨa mekanekɨne.
'Uxa'ariekake Tsetsareya paitɨ mekaneta'axɨani. Kuxineriyu kaniwakwewiekaitɨni yumarema meta yuhamikuma mɨwanaki'eriekai wahamatɨa.
Pekuru 'aye'aximekaku kiena, Kuxineriyu kanayeyani 'enunakeke. Hetɨana 'ukatunumakeka nenewieri kanipitɨani.
Matsi Pekuru kanenukuketɨani mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨawetɨ: —Kenanukukexi. Netsɨ 'ahepaɨ nekanitewitɨni.
Pekuru hamatɨana tikuxatatɨ kitana kaneutahani, kaniwaretaxeiya yuwaɨkawa meyuxeɨriekame.

Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xeme mɨpaɨ xepɨtemate, kemɨ'ane huriyu tewiyari mɨhɨkɨ pɨkatauniwa mɨtiwiyanikɨ xeime nuiwaritsie, wa'aurie mamienikɨ. Perutsɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ pɨnetiutahekɨatɨa tewi mɨkayɨwe mɨpaɨ mɨtayɨni kename tewi 'axa'ane kename ka'itiya.
'Ayumieme nekaneku'imawatɨ nekaninuani kepauka nemeyewitɨkie. Hikɨ nekanixeku'iwawiyanikeyu ¿titayari xenete'utanɨ'airi?
Kuxineriyu mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ranuka'atu nepɨnehakiekai 'epauka. Tau kɨa kakaiku ne ninenenewiekaitɨni nekiita. Yapauka xewitɨ nehɨxie putake 'ixuriki merɨkaɨyeme 'anakatɨtɨ
mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: “Kuxineriyu 'aku, Kakaɨyari 'anenewieri pu'eni meta yapɨretima kepemɨti'uximaya peti'akanenimayatɨ.
'Ayumieme, ketineutanɨ'a Kupe paitɨ. Tsimuni Pekuru mɨtitewa munuanikɨ. Mɨkɨ Tsimuni nawi 'uayame kie kanekani haramara tetsita. Nuame pɨmatitaxatɨani”.
Hikɨ kwitɨwa nekatiniutanɨ'ani. 'Ekɨtsɨ 'aixɨa pekatiniuyurieni pemunuakɨ. Hikɨtsɨari tanaitɨ 'uwa tepɨtaxeɨrie Kakaɨyari hɨxie, temi'enienikɨ naime Ti'aitame kemɨmati'aitɨa yapemɨtatitaxatɨanikɨ.
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Yurikɨ hikɨrixɨa mɨpaɨ nepɨretima, Kakaɨyari teɨteri yɨkɨ pɨkatiwaxeiya,
matsi yuxexuime nuiwarite watsata kemɨ'ane me'eyemakatɨ meta kemɨ'ane heitseriemekɨ yameteyurietɨ memu'uwa mɨkɨ pɨwaxeiya.

Kakaɨyari yuniuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne kaneyenɨ'ani 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme, mɨpaɨ hainekame kename Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu yu'iyaritsie memɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ wapitɨani. Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi yunaime tiwa'aitɨwame mɨhɨkɨ.
Xemeri xepɨtemate naitsarie Kureyatsie kemɨtiuyɨ, Karereyatsie tiutsutɨarieku kepauka Wani mɨtihekɨatakai kememɨteka'ɨyarienikekai.

Ketsutsi natsaretitanaka kanihɨkɨtɨni, kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari mikawiri 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata meta 'itɨrɨkariyatɨ. Mɨkɨ 'aniuyeikakaitɨni 'aixɨa tiyurienetɨ, yunaime Kauyumarie mɨwa'uximatɨakai 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame kaniwarayeitɨwakaitɨni, Kakaɨyari hamatɨana muyeikakaikɨ.
Tame tepɨhɨkɨ temunenierixɨ temɨtehekɨata naime hepaɨtsita kemɨtiuyuri huriyutsixi wakwiepa Kerutsaremetsie. Mɨkɨ mekanimieni kɨyetsie me'ikawiwatɨ.
Kakaɨyari kanenukuketɨani hairieka tukaritsie, kanipitɨani matsiɨkɨtɨ mayanikɨ,
yunaitɨ teɨteri meka'ixeiyakaku, tehekɨatamete xeikɨa Kakaɨyari mɨwaranuyexei matɨari paitɨ mekanixeiya, tame hamatɨana tekateniukwani meta tekateniu'ieni mɨkite watsata 'anukukeku.
Mɨkɨ pɨtatiuta'aitɨa teɨteri temɨtewakuxaxatɨwanikɨ, temɨtehekɨatanikɨ kename 'ikɨ hɨkɨ kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari mikaye memayeneniere meta mɨkite wa'itsɨkame mayanikɨ.
Hepaɨtsitanata yunaitɨ Kakaɨyari niukametemama mekatenihekɨatani mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ, mɨkɨ hetsiena yuri memɨte'erie katiniwareuyehɨwirieni tita 'axamemɨte'uyurikɨ hetsɨana memɨmiemetetɨnikɨ.
Hikɨ Pekuru mexi'akuxi niuki kuxatakaku, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata wahetsie katiniuwiya, yunaitɨ niukieya memu'eni wahetsie.
Yuri memɨte'eriekai Pekuru hamatɨa memu'axɨa memɨhuriyutsixitɨkai mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni memɨkahuriyutsixi mɨpaɨ memɨte'umikiekɨ, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata wahetsie mutatuiyakɨ.
Mepɨwa'eniekai niukitekɨ metekuxatame, 'aixɨa me'utiyuaneme Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita.
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Kepaitsɨ haa pɨwatikweririeni, 'ikɨ memɨka'ɨyarienikɨ? 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata meputanaki'eriexɨa tahepaɨ.
Katiniuta'aita memɨka'ɨyarienikɨ Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hetsiemieme. Hikɨ mekaniwarutawawirieni wahetsɨa 'akuxi yapaɨmexa tukari memuyuhayewanikɨ.
